money_and_execution.fee_in_cash_debit: gross $5 order plus any collateral-denominated fee; historical share-denominated fees reduce the payout shares instead
money_and_execution.order_minimum_shares: historical minimum not available; no current minimum was projected backward
money_and_execution.ev_rule: choose UP or DOWN with the larger positive expected net payout after ask depth and historical fee; otherwise skip
money_and_execution.execution_price: walk ask-side full depth to $5 gross; no midpoint or future quote
money_and_execution.quote_freshness_age_clock: source timestamp of the latest changed ask-side level; received timestamp gates availability and its age is retained separately
money_and_execution.fee_rate: latest fee_rate_bps last_trade_price event received at/before entry, divided by 10000
money_and_execution.fee_collection_mode: outcome shares before 2026-04-28 11:00 UTC; entries from 11:00 to 12:00 UTC excluded as exchange maintenance; collateral cash from 12:00 UTC onward
money_and_execution.legacy_fee_curve: fee shares = shares * rate * min(price, 1-price) / price; aggregate depth levels rounded down to 6 share decimals; PMXT does not expose maker-level fills/rounding
money_and_execution.collateral_fee_curve: cash fee = shares * rate * (price * (1-price))^1, exponent 1; historical exponent is not included in PMXT rows
money_and_execution.maker_fill_fee_precision_limit: book depth is aggregated; the archive has no maker-level matches. The replay rounds the cash fee for the aggregate order and share fees per aggregate price level, so exact per-match rounding cannot be recovered
money_and_execution.fee_accounting: fees_paid_usd reports the collateral fee or legacy share-fee value at execution price; cash_debit_usd adds fees only when historically charged in collateral
money_and_execution.settlement_cash_policy: cash plus cost basis of locked positions until official resolved_at_utc and the scenario release delay; no credit or deposits
money_and_execution.drawdown: peak-to-trough of available cash plus locked shares at entry cost; excludes intratrade mark-to-market

primary_scenario: prestart_c0_o1|age30|release60 (fixed accepted operational assumption: entry T-59s, one second after nominal T-60s; not a measured maximum or worst case)

quote_validation_economic_impact.earlier_scenario_matrix_status: retained from before the targeted fresh-BBO correction; use quote_validation_economic_impact.csv for same-T-59 stage comparisons
